blocks.text: define bubble style [STYLE] using text style [TEXT_STYLE]
blocks.description: Defines or replaces a bubble style and references a named SVG Text style.

blocks.text: set bubble placement [PLACEMENT] for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets an actor-relative direction/angle or a background-relative region. Direction aliases and Scratch-style degrees from 0 through 360 are accepted.

blocks.text: set portrait base [ASSET] for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets the registered image asset used as the portrait base. An empty asset removes the complete portrait.

blocks.text: set bubble distance [DISTANCE] for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets the distance from the actor bounds to the tail tip for actor-relative placement.

blocks.text: set bubble visual style [VISUAL_STYLE] for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets the SVG body shape used by this bubble style.

blocks.text: set bubble tail length [LENGTH] for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets the nominal length from the bubble border to the tail tip for actor-relative placement.

blocks.text: set bubble offset x [X] y [Y] scale [SCALE] % for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Offsets and scales the bubble body while keeping scale-only actor distance constant.

blocks.text: set blink frames [ASSETS] every [SECONDS] seconds for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets comma-separated registered image assets for the portrait blink layer. An empty list removes blink animation.

blocks.text: set lip-sync frames [ASSETS] every [SECONDS] seconds for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets comma-separated registered image assets for the portrait lip-sync layer. An empty list removes lip-sync animation.

blocks.text: set continue frames [ASSETS] every [SECONDS] seconds for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets at least two comma-separated registered image assets for the awaiting-continue indicator. An empty list removes the indicator.

blocks.text: set bubble reveal unit [UNIT] every [SECONDS] seconds layout [LAYOUT] for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets CHARACTER, WORD, LINE, or BLOCK sequential reveal. WORD uses the configured delimiters; DYNAMIC reflows as text grows and RESERVED reserves the final text size.

blocks.text: set bubble word delimiters [DELIMITERS] show [SHOW] for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets the character set used by WORD reveal and chooses whether delimiters remain visible.

blocks.text: set bubble reveal sound [ASSET] for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets a named audio asset played once per CHARACTER, WORD, LINE, or BLOCK reveal.

blocks.text: set bubble voice [ASSET] for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets the named full-voice audio asset played when the Bubble starts.

blocks.text: finish [UNIT] with condition [CONDITION] or timeout after [TIMEOUT] seconds
blocks.description: Reveals the remaining units and waits for the Runtime Expression condition or timeout before completing.

blocks.text: set bubble show animation [MOTION] for [SECONDS] seconds for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Selects the animation played when a Bubble starts displaying.

blocks.text: set bubble hide animation [MOTION] for [SECONDS] seconds for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Selects the animation played before a Bubble is closed. It works with both DYNAMIC and RESERVED layout.

blocks.text: animate this bubble [MOTION]
blocks.description: Plays an immediate display animation such as shake, explode, or a named show/hide motion.

blocks.text: shake this bubble direction [DIRECTION] count [COUNT] ease [EASE]
blocks.description: Shakes the complete Bubble surface, including portrait and text, with an easing selection.

blocks.text: explode this bubble relative scale [SCALE] count [COUNT] ease [EASE]
blocks.description: Changes the complete Bubble surface size by a relative amount for the requested number of cycles.

blocks.text: animate bubble shape to [VISUAL_STYLE] speed [SPEED] for [SECONDS] seconds
blocks.description: Transitions the Bubble outline to THINKING, DREAMING, YELLING, WAVY, WHISPERING, or another visual style.

blocks.text: say [MESSAGE] with bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Shows or replaces this sprite's layered say bubble in talking animation mode.

blocks.text: think [MESSAGE] with bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Shows or replaces this sprite's layered think bubble in talking animation mode.

blocks.text: set this bubble animation mode [MODE]
blocks.description: Changes this sprite's bubble animation mode. Awaiting continue stops lip-sync animation and starts the configured continue frames.

blocks.text: wait with this bubble until condition [CONDITION] or timeout after [TIMEOUT] seconds
blocks.description: Switches to awaiting-continue mode, evaluates a Runtime Expression condition using variables updated by Async Input, and waits until the condition is true or the timeout expires. Zero disables the timeout.

blocks.text: close this bubble
blocks.description: Closes this sprite's bubble and releases its timers, SVG text skin, and drawables.

blocks.text: Bubble version
blocks.description: Returns the Bubble implementation version.
